seqs=[x['sequence'] for x in top]

def infer(x): return model(x,training=False)

values=np.array(values,dtype=np.float64)
print('devices',tf.config.get_visible_devices())
for candidate,mean,std in zip(top,values.mean(0),values.std(0)):

print('cpu_margin',format(values.mean(0)[0]-values.mean(0)[1],'.12f'))
PY"
